# hunch check: examples

The shop repository's `feature` branch changes a payment retry to mint a new idempotency key each attempt, and loosens a test. `--base main` compares against it.

<!-- case: check-dry -->
### What would this cost?

```sh
npx @kelbie/hunch check --base main --dry-run
```

Exit code **0**.

stdout:

```text
hunch: dry run, nothing sent. 2 file(s) as 2 hunk(s): 15 question(s) in 3 request(s). Budget: 100 hunks, 100 requests, 180s.
```

<!-- /case -->
